promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版采用上文下图结构：上方集中放置主题文字和简短补充文案，下方放置完整主图或场景图。上下内容保持清晰的阅读顺序，图文关系自然，整体构图简洁。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use a text-above-image layout: place the theme copy and concise supporting text in the upper section, with a complete primary or scene illustration below. Keep a clear top-to-bottom reading order, let the text and image relate naturally, and keep the overall composition simple.

nameZh: 文案主导底部辅助图卡
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：视觉主体是文字，底部简单图案起辅助作用，图文之间有较大空间。纯色背景，较多留白空间，构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: text is the visual focal point; a simple graphic at the bottom plays a supporting role, with generous separation between text and image. Solid-color background, ample negative space, and a simple composition.

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：无独立标题，根据主题创作。上下带框两宫格，每一格都是上面一行字，下面配图，图文无明显分界，纯色背景，较多留白空间，角色高度概括，构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: no separate headline; create from the theme. Two framed panels stacked vertically; each panel has one line of text above an illustration, with no hard text-image division. Solid-color background, generous negative space, highly simplified characters, and a simple composition.

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：无独立标题，根据主题创作。上下带框两宫格，每一格都有一个图区和一个文字区，文字区可以在图的上方、左侧或右侧，文字区显示简单文案不做过多扩写，纯色背景，较多留白空间，角色高度概括，构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: no separate headline; create from the theme. Two framed panels stacked vertically; every panel has an image area and a text area. The text area may sit above, left, or right of the image and contains concise copy without excessive expansion. Solid-color background, generous negative space, highly simplified characters, and a simple composition.

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：无独立标题，视觉重点是使用主题的气泡文字，左下或右下放置一个思考状 IP 形象，构图简单，大面积留白。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: no separate headline; the visual focus is a thought-bubble text based on the theme, with a thinking IP character placed in the lower-left or lower-right. Keep the composition simple with generous negative space.

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版分为三层：上层放置主标题，中层放置一张尺寸较小、起辅助作用的简单图形，下层放置副标题。使用纯色背景，保留较多留白空间，整体构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use a three-level layout: place the main headline in the upper section, a small simple supporting illustration in the middle, and a secondary headline in the lower section. Use a solid-color background, generous negative space, and a simple overall composition.

promptZh: 小红书文字型社媒卡。排版：左上放置一个醒目的双引号，中间呈现主题文案并将关键词重点化，右下放置一条下划线；句末可以添加与文字大小适配的 emoji。保持文字主导的简洁构图。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu text-led social-media card. Layout: place a prominent opening quotation mark in the upper-left, present the theme copy in the center with key words emphasized, and add an underline in the lower-right. An emoji may appear at the end of the sentence, sized to match the text. Keep the composition simple and typography-led.

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版采用图上文下结构，上方是高度概括的角色或场景图，下方是主题文案；图文之间不设置明显界线，让视觉自然衔接。使用纯色背景，保留较多留白空间，整体构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use an image-above-text layout, with a highly simplified character or scene illustration above and the theme copy below. Do not add a visible boundary between the image and text; let them flow together naturally. Use a solid-color background, generous negative space, and a simple overall composition.

nameZh: 居中文字右下辅助图卡
promptZh: 小红书文字型社媒卡。排版：主题文字作为视觉主体，居中显示；右下角放置一个简单的小图作为辅助，不抢夺文字的视觉重点。整体构图简洁。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu text-led social-media card. Layout: make the theme text the visual focus and center it in the composition; place a small simple illustration in the lower-right corner as supporting content without competing with the text. Keep the overall composition simple.

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：无独立标题，根据主题创作上下带框的两宫格。每一格包含一行标题、约两三行的简短 list 文字和一张简单配图；文字保持简洁，不做过多扩写，图文之间不设置明显分界。使用纯色背景，保留较多留白空间，角色高度概括，整体构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: create two stacked framed panels based on the theme, without a separate overall headline. Each panel contains a one-line heading, a concise two- or three-line list, and a simple supporting illustration. Keep the copy brief without over-expanding it, avoid a visible boundary between text and image, use a solid-color background with generous negative space, simplify the characters, and keep the composition simple.

nameZh: 中心主图多场景信息卡
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：设置一个主标题，画面中央放置一个主图，周围安排 3–5 个与主体形象一致的简单信息图，并添加 2–3 个对主体的简短标注。使用纯色背景，保留较多留白空间，角色高度概括，整体构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: include a main headline, place one primary illustration in the center, surround it with 3–5 simple information illustrations that match the subject, and add 2–3 brief annotations about the subject. Use a solid-color background, generous negative space, highly simplified characters, and a simple overall composition.

nameVi: Tiêu đề giữa, icon vòng quanh
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：标题垂直居中显示，标题上方整齐安排两行图标，标题下方也整齐安排两行图标，形成围绕中心标题的上下对称结构。保持图标排列清晰、构图简单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: center the headline vertically, arrange two neat rows of icons above it, and arrange two more neat rows of icons below it to form a balanced structure around the central headline. Keep the icon arrangement clear and the composition simple.

nameZh: 留白驱动主视觉信息卡
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。整体保留大面积留白。顶部设置 1–2 行醒目的短标题，与主体区域形成清晰层级；中下部设置一个占据主要面积的大型主视觉，主视觉可居中、偏左或偏右，不固定位置，并通过主体自身的轮廓、姿态和占位关系自然形成若干留白区域。将 4–6 个尺寸较小的信息单元穿插在这些留白区域中，每个单元由一个小视觉元素与极短文字组成，位置服从主视觉留下的空间，不平均环绕主体，不形成规则左右分栏。小信息单元应明显小于主视觉并贴合主体轮廓的空隙，可上下错落、疏密变化，不能使用统一卡片框、规则宫格、表格或明显分割线。底部可保留一句很短的总结文字作为收尾。整体强调主视觉优先、留白驱动、信息穿插，画面完整而非模块拼接。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card with generous negative space. Place a prominent one- or two-line short headline at the top, clearly separated from the main subject area. In the middle and lower area, place one large primary visual occupying most of the composition; it may be centered, left-weighted, or right-weighted rather than locked to one position. Let the primary visual's silhouette, pose, and spatial footprint naturally create several areas of open space. Insert 4–6 smaller information units into those open spaces, each made of a small visual element and extremely short text. Let their positions follow the space left by the primary visual rather than preset columns; do not distribute them evenly around the subject or create regular side-by-side columns. Keep the small units clearly smaller than the primary visual and close to the gaps created by its outline, with varied vertical positions and density. Do not use uniform card frames, regular grids, tables, or obvious divider lines. A very short summary sentence may appear at the bottom as a closing element. Prioritize the main visual, let whitespace drive the placement, and weave information into the composition so it reads as one complete scene rather than assembled modules.

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。整体采用上下两段式结构，将画面分成两个面积接近的独立内容区域，中间保留清晰间距或细分隔关系。两个区域使用统一的视觉语言和相近的内部结构，形成对照、前后、转折或递进关系。每个区域设置一个醒目的核心短句作为第一视觉层级，并安排一个尺寸明显较大的单一主视觉，与核心文字形成左右或斜向的非对称平衡；主视觉位置可根据留白和整体重心调整。核心文字与主视觉之外的剩余留白中，放置 2–4 行简短补充文字，不形成独立卡片或规则列表。上下两个区域保持相似的视觉重量和阅读节奏，但不要求完全镜像复制，可通过标题位置、主视觉方向或留白分布产生轻微变化；第二个区域可加入很短的过渡词、转折词或关系提示。整体强调“上下双区＋大短句＋单一主视觉＋少量补充说明”，避免复杂信息图、密集文字、规则宫格和过多装饰，保持大面积留白、层级清楚、手机端快速阅读。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use a two-section vertical structure with two similarly sized content areas separated by clear spacing or a subtle divider. Give both sections a consistent visual language and related internal structure so they express contrast, before-and-after, a turn, or progression. Each section begins with a prominent core short phrase as the first visual level and includes one clearly large primary visual, creating an asymmetrical horizontal or diagonal balance with the phrase; adjust the visual's position according to whitespace and overall weight. Place concise two- to four-line supporting text in the remaining space, without making it a separate card or regular list. Keep the two sections similar in visual weight and reading rhythm without mirroring them exactly; vary the title position, visual direction, or whitespace distribution slightly. The second section may include a very short transition, contrast word, or relationship cue. Emphasize “two stacked sections + large short phrases + one primary visual per section + limited supporting copy.” Avoid complex infographics, dense text, regular grids, and excessive decoration; preserve generous negative space, clear hierarchy, and fast mobile reading.

nameVi: Chữ rất lớn, họa tiết nhỏ
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。整体采用极简的大留白结构，以一组大字号短文案作为绝对视觉主体。主文案放置在画面上半部或中上部，占据主要横向宽度，可使用 2–3 行自然换行；文字整体偏左排列，但不紧贴边缘，形成稳定的大块文字区域。主文案字号明显大于其他元素，行距相对紧凑，个别关键词可通过颜色、字重、底纹或轻微标记进行局部强调，但不要让多个词同时抢夺注意力。主文案下方保留较大的空白距离，在中央或略偏一侧放置一个尺寸很小的视觉点缀，作为第二视觉停顿，不承担主要信息。画面四角可以加入极少量微型辅助信息，例如日期、页码、符号或装饰点，字号和视觉重量都非常低。整体不设置卡片框、分栏、信息列表或复杂图文组合，背景保持简洁，强调大文字、少元素、大留白、弱装饰，形成轻盈安静、适合快速阅读的社媒封面感。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use an extremely minimal, spacious layout with a short piece of large typography as the absolute visual focus. Place the main copy in the upper or upper-middle area, spanning most of the available width and naturally wrapping across two or three lines. Align the text generally to the left without pressing it against the edge, creating a stable block. Make the main copy much larger than every other element with relatively tight line spacing. Emphasize only selected keywords through color, weight, a subtle background mark, or a light accent; do not let multiple words compete for attention. Leave generous space below the copy and place one very small visual accent in the center or slightly to one side as a secondary visual pause, without carrying primary information. The four corners may contain only a few tiny supporting details such as a date, page number, symbol, or decorative dot, all with very low visual weight. Do not use card frames, columns, information lists, or complex text-image combinations. Keep the background simple and emphasize large type, few elements, generous whitespace, and restrained decoration for a light, quiet, fast-to-read social cover.

nameVi: Nhãn tự do trên nền trống
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版：设置一个主标题，标签文字以自由、自然的方式分布在画面中，对画面里的角色、物件或场景元素做出简短注解，让文字参与整体构图。保留大面积留白，角色高度概括，减少装饰和复杂分区，保持构图简洁。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: include a main headline, then distribute label text freely and naturally across the composition to provide brief annotations for the characters, objects, or scene elements. Let the text participate in the overall composition. Preserve generous negative space, use highly simplified characters, minimize decoration and complex sections, and keep the composition clean.

nameZh: 中心主视觉环绕信息卡
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版采用中心主视觉环绕式结构：顶部设置两级短标题，其中主标题醒目。画面中央放置一个占比最大的主体人物或物体，作为绝对视觉中心；主体四周分散安排 3–6 个尺寸较小的独立插图，每个小图旁仅配一个极短标签或事项名称。小图采用自由、不规则的环绕分布，左右和下方错落排布，保持视觉平衡而非整齐网格。背景保留大面积留白，主图、小图、文字之间保持明显间距，形成“一大主体＋多个小信息点”的层级关系。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use a central-hero surrounding layout: place two levels of short headlines at the top, with the main headline prominent. Put one large person or object in the center as the absolute visual focus. Distribute 3–6 smaller independent illustrations around it, each accompanied by only an extremely short label or item name. Arrange the small illustrations freely and irregularly, staggered on the left, right, and below the hero rather than in a neat grid, while maintaining visual balance. Preserve generous negative space and clear gaps between the hero, small illustrations, and text to create a hierarchy of “one large subject plus multiple small information points.”

promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。排版采用“顶部标题＋中央大人物＋左右零散标签”的三级结构。画面顶部放置一句醒目的短标题，字号最大，居中或略偏左。画面中央放置一个完整人物作为绝对视觉主体，人物占画面高度约 60%–75%，从中上部延伸到底部，保持完整轮廓。人物左右两侧分散安排 3–5 个极短标签，每个标签仅一行或短词组，并用简短细线、斜线或引导线指向人物附近对应位置。标签上下错落、自由分布，左右保持视觉平衡，不做成规则列表。人物与文字之间保留充足间距，不遮挡人物主体。背景大面积留白，不增加复杂图块、卡片框、表格或多余装饰，确保手机端一眼可读。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use a clear three-level structure of “top headline + large central person + scattered labels on both sides.” Place one prominent short headline at the top in the largest type, centered or slightly left-aligned. Put one complete person in the center as the absolute visual focus; the person should occupy about 60%–75% of the image height, extend from the upper-middle area toward the bottom, and retain a complete silhouette. Distribute 3–5 extremely short labels on both sides, each limited to one line or a short phrase, with brief thin lines, slashes, or leader lines pointing toward nearby parts of the person. Stagger and distribute the labels freely rather than as a regular list, while keeping left-right balance. Leave generous space between the person and text without covering the subject. Preserve a largely empty background and avoid complex graphic blocks, card frames, tables, or extra decoration for immediate mobile readability.

nameZh: 一大一组非对称信息卡
nameVi: Một ảnh lớn, một cụm info
promptZh: 小红书社媒卡。整体采用“一大一组”的非对称结构。顶部设置 1–2 行醒目的短标题，形成独立标题区域，并与下方主体保持明显间距。中部设置一个占据主要面积的大型主视觉，整体偏向画面一侧；在相对另一侧集中安排 4–6 个尺寸明显更小的信息单元，形成连续、紧凑的次级信息组。主视觉可以位于左侧或右侧，信息组随之镜像调整，不固定具体方向。小信息单元不环绕主视觉四周，也不分散到画面两侧，可上下错落、两列穿插或疏密变化；每个单元由一个小视觉元素与极短文字组成。主视觉区域约占中部内容面积的 55%–70%，信息组约占 25%–40%，两者通过留白自然分隔，不使用分栏线、统一卡片框、表格或规则宫格。底部可保留一行很短的总结文字。整体强调“一个大视觉块＋一个集中小信息簇”，版面非对称但稳定，避免中心辐射、四周环绕、平均分布或满画面散点排版。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu social-media card. Use an asymmetrical “one large visual plus one group” structure. Place a prominent one- or two-line short headline in a dedicated top title area, clearly separated from the body below. In the middle, place one large primary visual occupying most of the content area and weighted toward one side; concentrate 4–6 much smaller information units in one continuous, compact secondary group on the opposite side. The primary visual may be on the left or right, with the information group mirrored accordingly rather than fixed to one direction. Do not scatter the small units around the hero or across both sides. Arrange them with staggered rows, interleaved columns, or varied density; each unit consists of a small visual element and extremely short text. Let the primary visual occupy about 55%–70% of the middle content area and the information group about 25%–40%, separating them through whitespace rather than divider lines, uniform card frames, tables, or regular grids. A very short summary line may appear at the bottom. Emphasize “one large visual block plus one concentrated small information cluster”: asymmetrical but stable, avoiding radial layouts, all-around placement, even distribution, or scattered elements across the whole canvas.

nameZh: 自适应双拼照片转译社媒卡
keywords: 自适应双拼照片转译社媒卡
promptZh:
小红书社媒卡。排版：自适应双拼照片艺术转译型。支持纯文本主题直出（由生图模型一体化生成）与上传照片垫图转绘。拼接时严禁修改或拉伸原图比例；完整画布由两块等大区域精准拼接：若为竖版原图采用左右 1:1 双拼横向并排，画布保持原图高度不变，总宽度精确为原图宽度的两倍（原图占左 50%，艺术转译区占右 50%）；若为横版原图/默认画幅采用上下 1:1 双拼纵向堆叠，画布保持原图宽度不变，总高度精确为原图高度的两倍（原图占上 50%，艺术转译区占下 50%）。由生图模型自主完成“真实摄影呈现 × 同一主体艺术风格转译”的前后虚实对照：

【真实摄影区（横版默认上方 / 竖版左侧）】：
由生图模型根据主题生成超写实、高质感的单反摄影真实照片（若用户上传了参考图则以其为准）。严格保持原图原始宽高比例与构图完整性，严禁拉伸变形或裁切。保持摄影真实景深、自然光线、真实皮肤/毛发质感与现场抓拍氛围，不做插画化重绘，作为风格转译前的真实摄影基准。

【艺术转译区（横版默认下方 / 竖版右侧）—— 彻底去写实与单义构图转译】：
1. 彻底去写实化与画风从零重绘（坚决杜绝照片套滤镜）：
艺术转译侧必须与摄影侧形成极具冲击力的跨媒介反差！坚决不要在原照片的写实五官与光影体积上直接套滤镜或贴材质。必须“只提取摄影区人物的五官标志特征、姿态神态与场景大轮廓”，在画风上完全按所选风格从零重绘为纯粹的 2D 手绘/艺术插画，让所选风格的笔触、线条、专属配色与质感辨识度最大化释放。

2. 坚决彻底剔除原片环境杂质（留白是第一原则，严禁照抄全景背景）：
严禁把摄影区的杂乱场景（如整面石墙、地面小路、大片树丛天空等）机械复制到转译区！转译侧画面四周边缘必须保留充足、干净的 40%–80% 负空间/呼吸留白底色（暖象牙白、米白棉麻纸纹），主体与文字向内部收拢，绝不贴边、绝不爆框。

3. 单一明确的构图转译语法与轮替机制（严格 Round-Robin 轮替，严禁千篇一律与多选平铺）：
若用户未显式指定构图，AI 提示词生成器（Prompter Agent）在每次生成时必须按顺序在以下五大核心玩法中进行严格轮替（Round-Robin 轮替抽卡，严禁连续输出同一玩法），并为选定的唯一玩法生成单义、排他的执行指令：
- 【玩法一：越界破框型】：在纯白底色中设置单枚低饱和几何色块/容器，主体大部分在色块内，但关键部位（头部/手部/枝叶）自然突破色块边缘伸出，形成空间穿透感；
- 【玩法二：微缩浮岛型】：主体大幅微缩为占画面 10%–25% 的精致纸面小景，仅由一抹清淡色带或基座承托，四周呈现大片静谧空旷留白；
- 【玩法三：记忆图谱平铺型】：打破单一场景，居中放置主体，并在留白中错落平铺 3–6 枚原图记忆特征贴纸（带 NO. 编号），间距透光；

4. 编辑式微排版（文字优雅嵌入负空间）：
在空白负空间中巧妙排布 1–2 组与主题相关的精致微排版（手绘艺术标题、英文短句、编号标签或随笔小文案），字迹纤细克制。

整体要求：拼接时严禁修改原图比例；加上艺术转译区后，整张图片宽度精确为原图宽度的两倍（左右双拼）或高度精确为原图高度的两倍（上下双拼）；双拼两区在中线处平齐无缝拼接，无多余边框；艺术转译侧四周确保留出充足负空间与呼吸边距；由生图模型自主完成“极致真实摄影 × 极致纯正手绘艺术”对比鲜明、四周留白舒展的高级艺术画报。

nameZh: 姓名四款签名设计展示卡
nameVi: Bốn kiểu chữ ký theo tên
keywords: 姓名四款签名设计展示卡
promptZh:
【中文姓名】：{例如：唐伯虎}
【姓名拼音】：{例如：TANG BOHU}
【顶部背景色】：{例如：深钴蓝}
【画幅比例】：9:16

将输入的【中文姓名】制作成一张“姓名 → 四种签名方案”的竖版设计稿。

## 一、整体排版

画面比例为 9:16。

上方约占画面 40%，用于展示原始姓名。

下方约占画面 60%，用于展示同一个姓名的四种不同签名方案。

---

## 二、顶部姓名区

顶部使用【顶部背景色】。

顶部中央放置小字：

NAME TO SIGNATURE

画面中部展示【中文姓名】。

姓名必须使用普通印刷字体，不使用手写、连笔、签名字体或艺术变形，用于明确表示原始输入姓名。

中文姓名下方显示：

【姓名拼音】

姓名拼音使用大写英文字母。

顶部区域不添加其他文案、Logo、编号或图形。

---

## 三、底部签名区

底部划分为 2×2 四个区域。

使用细虚线进行横向和纵向分隔，不需要外边框。

四格分别展示同一个【中文姓名】的四种签名设计：

左上：飘逸
右上：锋势
左下：回环
右下：极简

每格只包含：

1. 一个大尺寸签名
2. 下方一个小字号风格名称

四个签名都必须来源于同一个【中文姓名】，但不能只是把完整姓名换四种相似写法。

允许对姓名进行：

省笔、合笔、连笔、共享笔画、压缩、拉长、缩写、拆解、重组、符号化。

不要求每一个中文字都完整可辨。

重点是保留姓名的部分结构特征，同时形成四种明显不同的签名骨架。

---

## 四、四种签名笔势

### 1. 飘逸

整体横向展开。

姓名高度压缩，多个字之间可以连续连写、共享笔画。

以连续曲线为主，笔势流畅。

可以使用一至两条跨度较大的长线，将整个签名串联起来。

允许出现较长的横向拖尾。

整体结构强调：

长线、曲线、连续、舒展、流动。

减少过多尖角和短促折线。

---

### 2. 锋势

整体具有明显向右推进的趋势。

大量使用：

斜线、尖角、高竖笔、快速切线、短促折笔。

姓名可以高度压缩，只保留主要骨架。

整体允许明显右倾。

主笔可以形成较强的上挑、下切、斜向穿插关系。

减少大面积圆形和柔软回环。

整体结构强调：

斜向、锐角、切线、速度、力量。

---

### 3. 回环

以一个或多个大型回环结构作为签名主体。

可以使用：

开放圆环、椭圆曲线、大型 S 曲线、连续回转线、包围结构。

将姓名压缩后的主要笔画嵌入回环内部，或让姓名笔画穿过回环。

最后一笔可以突破主体，形成较长收尾。

回环不能过于规则，应保留自然手写产生的不对称。

整体结构强调：

回旋、包围、穿插、连续曲线、大尺度手势。

---

### 4. 极简

不完整书写整个姓名。

从【中文姓名】中提取约 4–6 个最有识别价值的主要笔画，例如：

长横、主竖、折笔、斜线、撇捺、点笔。

重新组合成一个简化的个人签名标记。

允许大幅度省略原姓名结构。

整体笔画数量明显少于其他三款。

避免添加与姓名无关的装饰图形。

整体结构强调：

少笔画、大留白、强骨架、符号化。

---

## 五、四款差异控制

四种方案必须在以下方面产生明显区别：

- 笔画数量
- 横向或斜向趋势
- 曲线与直线比例
- 是否存在大型回环
- 是否完整保留姓名
- 重心位置
- 连笔方式
- 收尾方向
- 整体轮廓

四款不能只是修改同一个签名的尾笔。

应形成四种不同结构：

飘逸：长曲线 + 连续连写
锋势：斜线 + 尖角 + 强方向性
回环：大型曲线 + 包围结构
极简：少量核心笔画 + 高度符号化

最终只需要保留姓名、拼音、四个签名和四个风格名称，不添加其他内容。
promptEn:
[Chinese Name]: {e.g., Tang Bohu}
[Name Pinyin]: {e.g., TANG BOHU}
[Top Background Color]: {e.g., Deep Cobalt Blue}
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16

Render the input [Chinese Name] into a vertical design presentation titled "Name to Four Signature Concepts".

## 1. Overall Layout

Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical poster layout.

The top ~40% of the canvas presents the original source name.

The bottom ~60% of the canvas presents four distinct signature design concepts created for the exact same name.

---

## 2. Top Name Header Area

The top section uses [Top Background Color].

Small header text centered near the very top:

NAME TO SIGNATURE

The center of the top section features [Chinese Name].

The name must strictly use clean, standard printed typography (serif or sans-serif)—no handwriting, cursive ligatures, artistic distortion, or signature fonts—to clearly establish the original baseline name.

Directly beneath the Chinese name, display:

[Name Pinyin]

The name pinyin must be rendered in clean uppercase Latin letters.

No additional copy, logos, numbers, or graphics in the top area.

---

## 3. Bottom Signature Grid Area

The bottom area is divided into a 2×2 four-quadrant grid.

Use thin, subtle dashed dividing lines horizontally and vertically; no outer framing border.

The four quadrants display four signature design concepts for the exact same [Chinese Name]:

Top-left: 飘逸 (Flowing / Elegant)
Top-right: 锋势 (Sharp / Dynamic)
Bottom-left: 回环 (Looping / Enclosing)
Bottom-right: 极简 (Minimalist / Symbolic)

Each quadrant contains strictly:
1. One prominent, large-scale signature design
2. One small-sized style name label underneath

All four signatures must be derived from the exact same [Chinese Name], but must never be mere slight variations of the same handwriting.

Permitted transformations on the name:
Stroke omission, stroke merging, cursive ligatures, shared strokes, compression, elongation, abbreviation, deconstruction, recombination, and symbolization.

It is NOT required for every Chinese character to remain fully legible.
The key objective is to preserve partial structural identity of the name while establishing four fundamentally distinct signature structural skeletons.

---

## 4. Four Signature Gestural Styles

### 1. 飘逸 (Flowing / Elegant)

Overall horizontal expansive posture.
The name characters are highly compressed and continuously joined with shared strokes across characters.
Dominated by fluid continuous curves with smooth gestural momentum.
May utilize one or two sweeping long strokes that unify the entire signature.
Allows an extended horizontal trailing flourish.
Structural emphasis:
Long strokes, fluid curves, continuous ligatures, expansive rhythm, dynamic flow.
Minimize sharp angles and abrupt hard turns.

---

### 2. 锋势 (Sharp / Dynamic)

Pronounced rightward thrust and forward momentum.
Heavily utilizes:
Diagonal slashes, acute angles, tall vertical strokes, rapid cutting strokes, and brisk geometric angular folds.
Name characters can be highly compressed, retaining only core skeleton strokes.
The entire signature may lean noticeably to the right.
Primary strokes form bold upward slashes, downward cuts, and diagonal interlocks.
Minimize large circular curves and soft loops.
Structural emphasis:
Diagonal thrust, acute angles, swift cutting lines, speed, and sharp tension.

---

### 3. 回环 (Looping / Enclosing)

Built around one or more large enclosing loops as the primary signature gesture.
May incorporate:
Open rings, elliptical loops, grand S-curves, continuous whirling lines, and protective surrounding structures.
The compressed primary strokes of the name are nestled inside the loops or pierced by the sweeping loop trajectory.
The final finishing stroke may break free of the main body with an expressive outward trail.
Loops must not look mechanically circular; preserve the organic asymmetry of natural swift calligraphy.
Structural emphasis:
Whirling loops, enclosure, penetration, continuous curves, large-scale gestures.

---

### 4. 极简 (Minimalist / Symbolic)

Does NOT write out the entire name.
Extracts only ~4–6 most recognizable structural strokes from [Chinese Name], such as:
A long horizontal bar, a dominant vertical, an angular fold, a swift diagonal, a slash/press stroke, or an anchor dot.
Recombines them into an ultra-clean, modernized personal signature mark / monogram.
Permits radical omission of conventional character anatomy.
Stroke count is drastically fewer than the other three concepts.
Avoid decorative geometric graphics unrelated to the name.
Structural emphasis:
Few strokes, generous breathing whitespace, bold essential skeleton, high symbolic abstraction.

---

## 5. Differentiation Control

The four concepts must exhibit striking, undeniable structural differences across:
- Stroke density and stroke count
- Horizontal vs. diagonal directional momentum
- Curve-to-straight line ratio
- Presence vs. absence of large enclosing loops
- Degree of name legibility vs. radical abbreviation
- Center of visual gravity
- Ligature connection logic
- Terminal flourish direction
- Overall silhouette profile

The four designs must not simply be one signature with four different tail endings.
They must establish four distinct structural philosophies:
Flowing: Long curves + continuous ligatures
Sharp: Diagonals + acute angles + decisive directional thrust
Looping: Monumental curves + enclosing loop architecture
Minimalist: Sparse core strokes + radical symbolic abstraction

Final image strictly retains only the name, pinyin, four signatures, and four style labels; no extraneous decorative elements.

promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: include a main headline and build the body as a timeline, with one clear main axis connecting multiple nodes. The timeline may run horizontally or vertically. Each node contains one small illustration, a time marker, and one concise sentence. Keep the sequence clear and the hierarchy legible, preserve generous negative space, and avoid complex decoration or excessive text.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：阶段进阶型，重点展示由低到高的等级变化和阶段提升，不以时间先后为组织依据。顶部设置简短醒目的主标题，主体可采用阶梯、上升箭头或清晰的层级结构，使进阶方向一目了然。各阶段配简洁小图、等级名称和简短说明，层级关系清楚，文字从简。保留大面积留白和舒适的阶段间距，构图简洁。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: stage progression, emphasizing changes in level and advancement from lower to higher stages rather than chronological order. Place a short, prominent headline at the top. Use stairs, an ascending arrow, or a clear hierarchical structure to make the direction of progression immediately readable. Pair each stage with a simple small illustration, a level name, and a brief description. Keep the hierarchy clear and the wording concise. Preserve generous negative space, comfortable spacing between stages, and a simple composition.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：Before / After 型，前后变化是绝对视觉重点。将画面组织为前后两个主要区域，可以左右排列，也可以上下排列；两部分之间只放箭头、日期或极少量说明，用来表达变化方向。Before 与 After 各自呈现完整、可直接比较的主视觉，标签和文字保持简洁。保留大面积留白，避免复杂装饰和过多辅助信息。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: Before / After comparison, with the change between the two states as the absolute visual focus. Organize the composition into two primary areas, arranged either side by side or one above the other. Place only an arrow, a date, or very limited explanatory text between them to show the direction of change. Give both Before and After a complete main visual that can be compared directly, and keep labels and wording concise. Preserve generous negative space and avoid complex decoration or excessive supporting information.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：分层结构型，围绕天然存在的层级关系组织信息，可以表现为上中下、内中外、表层深层或由基础到核心的多层结构。设置清晰的主标题，主体通过层层嵌套、上下分层或由下至上的结构展示不同层级；每一层配简洁名称、短句或小图，保持层级顺序和阅读关系明确。保留大面积留白，避免复杂装饰、过密文字和无关模块。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: layered structure, organizing information around an inherent hierarchy such as top-middle-bottom, inner-middle-outer, surface-deep, or a multi-level structure from foundation to core. Include a clear main headline. Use nested layers, stacked sections, or a bottom-to-top structure to present the hierarchy; each layer may include a concise name, short sentence, or small illustration. Keep the order and reading relationship clear, preserve generous negative space, and avoid complex decoration, dense text, or unrelated modules.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：漏斗型，上宽下窄，通过逐层收窄的结构展示从广泛进入、筛选、转化、淘汰到聚焦沉淀的过程。设置清晰的主标题，漏斗各层配简洁的阶段名称、短句或小图，突出人数、对象或范围逐步减少而重点逐步集中的关系。层级顺序应清楚，保留大面积留白，避免复杂装饰和过多文字。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: funnel-shaped, wide at the top and narrow at the bottom, using progressively narrowing layers to show a process from broad entry, filtering, and conversion to elimination and focused retention. Include a clear main headline. Give each funnel layer a concise stage name, short sentence, or small illustration, emphasizing that the people, objects, or scope become smaller while the focus becomes stronger. Keep the hierarchy clear, preserve generous negative space, and avoid complex decoration or excessive text.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：矩阵型，以两条相互垂直的轴将内容划分为四个象限，优先采用清晰易读的 2×2 结构。设置一个主标题，并明确标注横轴、纵轴及其两端含义；每个象限放置一个主题单元，可包含简短标题、小图和少量说明。四个区域保持对齐、间距均衡和比较关系明确，保留大面积留白，避免复杂装饰和过多文字。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: matrix type, using two perpendicular axes to divide the content into four quadrants, preferably as a clear and readable 2×2 structure. Include a main headline and label the horizontal axis, vertical axis, and the meaning of both ends. Place one thematic unit in each quadrant, with a concise title, small illustration, and limited explanation. Keep the four areas aligned, evenly spaced, and easy to compare. Preserve generous negative space and avoid complex decoration or excessive text.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：坐标散点型，在一个清晰的坐标空间中散布多个不同对象，通过它们在横轴和纵轴上的位置表达分类、倾向或关系。设置一个主标题，明确标注横轴、纵轴及两端含义；每个对象由简洁的小图、名称和少量说明组成，位置分布应有辨识度并便于比较。保留坐标区域周围的大面积留白，避免复杂装饰和过多文字。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: coordinate scatter type, placing multiple different objects within a clear coordinate space and using their positions along the horizontal and vertical axes to express categories, tendencies, or relationships. Include a main headline and clearly label both axes and the meaning of their ends. Represent each object with a simple small illustration, name, and limited explanation; make the positions distinctive and easy to compare. Preserve generous negative space around the coordinate area and avoid complex decoration or excessive text.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：分类树 / 树状型，从一个核心大类或根节点开始，向下分成若干主要小类，再继续分解为更细的子类或末端节点。设置清晰的主标题，根节点位于顶部或中心上方，各级节点通过连线体现所属关系和分支路径。每个节点使用简短名称或极少说明，层级深度、分支顺序和阅读路径必须清楚。保留适度留白，避免过度装饰和无关信息。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: category tree or hierarchy tree, beginning with one core category or root node and branching downward into several major subcategories, then continuing into more detailed child or terminal nodes. Include a clear main headline. Place the root at the top or upper center, and use connecting lines to show parent-child relationships and branch paths. Give each node a concise name or minimal explanation; the hierarchy depth, branch order, and reading path must remain clear. Keep appropriate negative space and avoid excessive decoration or unrelated information.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：思维导图型，中心主题作为核心节点，向外延伸多条分支；每条分支包含若干短标签或小图标，清楚表达从中心到子主题的层级关系。避免规则表格和过密文字，使用自然弯曲的连线、适度留白和简洁角色概括形成清晰阅读路径。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: mind-map type, with one central topic as the core node and multiple branches extending outward. Each branch contains concise labels or small icons, clearly expressing the hierarchy from the center to subtopics. Avoid rigid tables and dense text; use natural curved connectors, generous negative space, and simplified characters to create a clear reading path.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：关系网络型，多个对象分布在画面中，用不同颜色或粗细的连线表达合作、影响、依赖或关联关系。可以只有弱中心，不要求所有节点平均分布；节点名称保持简短，整体留白充足，避免复杂表格和密集说明。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: relationship network, with multiple objects distributed across the canvas and connectors of varied color or weight showing collaboration, influence, dependency, or association. A weak center is acceptable and nodes do not need to be evenly distributed. Keep labels concise, preserve generous negative space, and avoid dense tables or explanations.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：循环闭环型，多个阶段围成圆形或环形路径，用连续箭头串联，强调持续循环、反馈和迭代，而不是开始到结束的单向流程。中心保留标题或核心结论，节点配小图和短句，留白清楚，避免拥挤。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: closed-loop cycle, with several stages arranged in a circular path and connected by continuous arrows. Emphasize repetition, feedback, and iteration rather than a one-way beginning-to-end process. Keep a title or key conclusion in the center, pair nodes with small visuals and short phrases, and preserve clear negative space.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：路径地图型，一条弯曲、蜿蜒或游戏地图式路线贯穿画面，沿途安排多个编号节点、地点或阶段。每个节点配一个小视觉和一句短说明，用箭头、虚线或路标表达探索方向；不必是真实地图，重点是路径和节点关系，保留大面积留白。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: path-map type, with one winding or game-map-like route crossing the canvas and several numbered nodes, locations, or stages along it. Pair each node with a small visual and one short explanation, using arrows, dashed lines, or signposts to show direction. It does not need to be a real map; emphasize the route and node relationships while preserving generous negative space.

nameZh: 真实地图标注型信息图
promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：真实地图与标注型，以真实地图轮廓、街区、水系或区域关系作为主视觉，在地图上放置地点标记、极短说明和少量小图标。标注需避开主体遮挡，层级清楚，图例简洁，避免把地图做成密集列表。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: real map with annotations, using an authentic map outline, streets, waterways, or regional relationships as the main visual. Place location markers, very short explanations, and a few small icons on the map. Keep annotations away from important features, maintain clear hierarchy, and use a simple legend rather than a dense list.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：数字大字型，以一个或多个超大数字作为绝对视觉主体，周围只放极短解释、单位或对象名称。数字要占据主要面积并形成强烈冲击，其他元素弱化，背景大面积留白，不加入复杂图表。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: oversized-number type, using one or more huge numbers as the absolute visual focus. Surround them only with very short explanations, units, or object names. Let the numbers occupy the main area with strong impact, subordinate all other elements, keep the background generously empty, and avoid complex charts.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：排行榜型，按1、2、3、4、5的明确顺序排列对象。每个对象配一个小图、名称和一项核心数据，可采用纵向排行、奖台或错落分层结构。重点突出名次差异和第一视觉对象，避免退化成普通无序清单。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: ranking type, arranging objects in an explicit order such as 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. Pair each object with a small visual, a name, and one core metric. Use a vertical ranking, podium, or staggered tiered structure, emphasizing rank differences and the leading entry rather than making a generic unordered list.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：比例构成型，使用圆环图、饼图、100人图标或色块面积表达整体中各部分所占比例。设置清晰图例和少量百分比标注，主图最大，说明简短，颜色区分明确，留白充足，避免堆叠过多指标。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: part-to-whole composition, using a donut chart, pie chart, 100-person icons, or area blocks to show how much each part contributes to the whole. Include a clear legend and only a few percentage labels. Make the main chart dominant, keep explanations short, distinguish colors clearly, and avoid too many metrics.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：尺度比较型，让多个对象按真实或相对大小从小到大排列，视觉尺寸本身直接传递比较信息。对象高度概括，配极短名称或阶段标签，用基线、箭头或少量刻度强化递进关系，保持构图简单和大面积留白。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: scale comparison, arranging multiple objects from small to large according to real or relative size so that visual scale itself communicates the comparison. Keep objects highly simplified, add only very short names or stage labels, and use a baseline, arrow, or a few marks to reinforce progression. Keep the composition simple with generous negative space.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：拆解爆炸图型，一个完整物体作为主体，多个零件或组件从主体中分离并围绕主体展开，用引导线说明每个组件的名称、用途或组成关系。重点表现“由什么组成”，不要做成普通标注图；角色高度概括，构图简单，大量留白。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: exploded-view type, with one complete object as the main subject and multiple parts separated and expanded around it. Use leader lines to identify each component and explain its purpose or compositional relationship. Emphasize what the object is made of rather than making a generic annotation diagram. Keep characters highly simplified, the composition simple, and the negative space generous.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：剖面 / 截面型，把一个整体建筑或物体切开，直接展示内部空间、楼层和功能分区。剖面主视觉占据主要面积，旁侧配置少量楼层标签或极短说明，切口和内部结构必须完整可读，角色高度概括，保留大量留白。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: sectional or cutaway type, slicing an integrated building or object open to reveal its interior spaces, floors, and functional zones. Let the cutaway be the dominant visual, with only a few floor labels or very short notes alongside it. Keep the cut edge and internal structure fully readable, simplify characters, and preserve generous negative space.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：连续场景型，整张图是一幅连贯的空间或时间场景，多个信息节点自然藏在道路、人物、建筑和道具中。不要拆成卡片或规则网格；用场景关系串联信息，角色高度概括，构图简洁，保留大片天空、地面或背景留白。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: continuous-scene type, with the entire image forming one connected spatial or temporal scene and multiple information nodes naturally embedded in paths, people, buildings, and props. Do not split it into cards or a rigid grid; connect information through the scene itself, simplify characters, keep the composition clean, and preserve broad areas of sky, ground, or background negative space.

nameZh: 人物群像标签型信息图
promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：人物群像 + 标签型，多个角色自由站位，不必形成规则宫格。每个角色配一个短标签或极短说明，角色之间保持清楚间距和视觉平衡，可用姿态、道具和大小差异表达区别。角色高度概括，背景大面积留白，避免复杂装饰。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: character group with labels, using multiple characters in free positions rather than a rigid grid. Pair each character with one short label or very brief explanation, keeping clear spacing and visual balance. Use posture, props, and size differences to distinguish them. Keep characters highly simplified, leave the background generously empty, and avoid complex decoration.

nameZh: 一大多小知识图谱型信息图
nameVi: Đồ thị tri thức 1 lớn nhiều nhỏ
promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：一大多小知识图谱型，设置一个占据主要面积的大型核心图，作为画面最重要的视觉主体；在核心图周围分布若干尺寸明显更小的视觉单元，每个单元配一个极短标签、名称或说明。小单元围绕核心主题形成知识关联，但不要求规则网格或完全平均分布；通过留白、位置和适度连接表达整体关系。角色高度概括，构图简单，保留大量留白。
promptEn: Place one large core illustration occupying the main visual area as the primary subject. Distribute several clearly smaller visual units around it, with each unit paired with a very short label, name, or explanation. Let the smaller units form knowledge relationships around the core topic without requiring a rigid grid or perfectly even distribution. Use negative space, position, and light connections to express the overall relationship. Keep characters highly simplified, use a simple composition, and preserve generous negative space.

promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：百科全书式信息卡。采用“顶部主标本展示区 + 中部非对称多模块信息区 + 底部资料来源区”的三段式结构。顶部以主视觉实物/标本为核心，搭配标题、学名/副标题、分类标签与少量基础信息。中部通过细线网格、坐标系统和黄金分割组织6–10个信息模块，混合小标题、短文、图解、对比、数据条、地图、时间轴等形式，整体图文混排、秩序清晰、留白充足。底部设置弱化的编号、注释或来源说明区，整体呈现标本馆档案与现代博物馆导览牌融合的理性设计感。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: Encyclopedic information card. Structured in three tiers: "top primary specimen display zone + middle asymmetrical multi-module information zone + bottom source reference zone". The top is centered around a primary visual object/specimen, accompanied by the main title, scientific name/subtitle, classification tags, and concise foundational details. The middle section organizes 6–10 information modules through hairline grids, coordinate systems, and golden-ratio compositions, integrating subheadings, short paragraphs, diagrams, comparative charts, data bars, maps, and timelines into a well-ordered, generous typographic balance. The bottom contains an understated numbering, footnote, or reference citation area, presenting a rational design aesthetic combining herbarium archival sheets with contemporary museum exhibition boards.

nameZh: 手绘编辑式知识信息图
promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：手绘编辑式知识信息图。采用“顶部超大标题 + 中部大型核心主视觉 + 周边多个带数字编号的知识点模块 + 底部总结区”的构图。核心主视觉明显大于其他元素，作为全图视觉中心；周围自然环绕分布4–8个知识点模块，每个模块带有清晰醒目的数字序号（如01、02、03、04）建立列表感与阅读动线。每个编号模块包含短标题、简短说明和一个小型视觉解释（如小场景插图、图标、对比、流程、思维泡泡或微型漫画）。模块围绕核心视觉灵活排布，非僵硬规则宫格，允许箭头、标签、对话气泡与手写注释穿插连接。底部设置一句话总结、关键词提炼或checklist清单区收束全图。整体呈现杂志编辑插画、知识信息图与轻漫画叙事融合的生动手绘质感。角色高度概括，构图简洁，较多留白。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: Hand-drawn editorial knowledge infographic. Structured as "top oversized headline + central prominent hero visual + surrounding numbered knowledge modules + bottom summary section". The central hero visual is substantially larger than other elements, serving as the dominant visual focal point. 4 to 8 knowledge modules surround the core illustration naturally, each bearing a prominent numbered badge (such as 01, 02, 03, 04) to establish a clear reading sequence and list structure. Each numbered module contains a concise title, brief explanation, and miniature visual breakdown (such as mini-scene illustrations, icons, comparisons, process flows, thought bubbles, or mini comic panels). Modules flow organically around the core visual rather than adhering to a rigid grid, connected flexibly by arrows, tags, speech bubbles, and handwritten notes. The bottom features a concluding one-line takeaway, keywords, or checklist. The overall composition merges magazine editorial illustration, knowledge infographic diagramming, and light comic narrative into a lively hand-drawn aesthetic. Keep characters highly simplified, use a concise composition, and preserve generous negative space.

nameZh: 讲义式高密分析信息图
keywords: 讲义式高密分析信息图
promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：讲义式高密分析信息图。一页高信息密度的讲义式分析排版，整体呈现“先总览、再分解、再总结”的清晰结构。顶部设置主标题栏与核心要点/速览区；中部为主体分析区，由多个带编号的独立分析卡片模块组成，各模块包含要点小标题、项目符号清单、公式框与局部图解说明，并穿插表格容器、步骤流程区与思维导图/流程连接区，通过不同大小的内容区形成丰富的视觉节奏；底部设置通栏重点结论区与易错提醒/避坑说明区，辅以边缘补充说明区与角落批注小框。版面遵循从上到下、从左到右的严谨阅读顺序，分区明确、容器边框分明，不做海报式单一视觉中心布局，不做机械均分网格，不添加知识点以外的纯装饰性图像元素。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: High-density handout analytical infographic. A single-page, high-density structured study handout layout following a clear "overview, breakdown, and summary" visual hierarchy. The top features a prominent main header bar paired with a core key takeaways/overview panel. The middle section serves as the core analytical body, composed of multiple sequentially numbered modular cards featuring subheadings, bullet points, formula containers, and localized diagrammatic explanations, flexibly interspersed with structured table containers, step-by-step procedure sequences, and flowchart/decision-tree connection zones to create an engaging visual rhythm across varied block sizes. The bottom anchors the page with full-width key conclusion and warning/error-alert callout sections, complemented by marginal annotations and compact corner callout boxes. The layout follows a strict top-to-bottom, left-to-right reading order with distinct container boundaries and structured card frames; avoids single-focal-point poster composition, avoids rigid equal grids, and strictly excludes decorative imagery outside essential informational diagrams.

nameZh: 编辑式等距轴测全景地图信息图
keywords: 编辑式等距轴测全景地图信息图
promptZh: 小红书信息图。排版：编辑式等距轴测全景地图信息图。采用纵向长幅构图，以一个连续展开的等距轴测微缩世界作为画面主体。主视觉像一座沿纵向自然生长的小型城市、主题乐园或幻想产业园，由多个大小差异明显、造型各异的独立场景节点组成。整个轴测世界集中在画面中央区域，但不要铺满画布，四周保留大量纯净背景和呼吸空间。场景节点不要按照规则网格排列，也不要切成等大的流程模块。建筑、设施、商店、工厂、交通工具、特殊装置等以不规则方式错落组合，通过道路、车辆、传送结构、空间方向或视觉动线产生联系。构图强调“一张完整世界地图”，而不是“多个步骤依次排开的流程图”。可以存在流程关系，但流程隐藏在空间叙事之中，不使用明显的大箭头串联所有节点。核心节点可以明显放大，次要节点缩小，局部甚至可以出现非常夸张的大型标志物、广告牌、纪念碑式装置、特殊建筑或巨型物件，以制造视觉节奏和幽默感。文字信息不要覆盖整个画面。标题、编号、简短说明、小型图例和局部注释主要放在画面外围留白区域，与附近场景进行弱连接。避免大量白色信息卡、统一尺寸说明框、规则章节标题和密集参数表。整体采用极简的二维轴测线稿插画语言：辅助色A细线轮廓、辅助色B建筑主体、主色背景及少量主色填色，基本限制在三色体系。无渐变、无真实材质、无复杂光影。建筑与设备保持高度概括、图标化和卡通化，不追求工程结构准确度；加入大量非常小的人物、动物、车辆和幽默互动细节，使整个世界具有“主题乐园地图 / 杂志插画地图 / 品牌世界观海报”的感觉。重点：大留白、中央连续轴测世界、不规则节点、大小强对比、外围零散注释、趣味叙事。避免：满版工业园、规则分区、标准流程卡、密集文字框、大量流程箭头、写实工厂、工程制图感、所有节点尺寸一致。
promptEn: Xiaohongshu infographic. Layout: Editorial Isometric Illustrated Map Infographic. A vertical long-format composition featuring a continuously unfolding isometric miniature world as the core visual subject. The main visual resembles a vertically growing miniature city, theme park, or fantasy industrial park, composed of multiple independent scene nodes varying noticeably in scale and form. The entire isometric world is centered in the canvas without filling the edges, reserving ample clean background and breathing room around the perimeter. Scene nodes are not arranged in a rigid grid or divided into uniform process modules; instead, architecture, facilities, shops, workshops, vehicles, and quirky contraptions are arranged irregularly, linked via roads, vehicles, conveyor structures, spatial orientation, and visual flow lines. The composition emphasizes "a complete world map" rather than a step-by-step flowchart; procedural relations may exist, but are seamlessly woven into spatial storytelling without prominent oversized arrows. Core nodes are visibly enlarged while secondary nodes are scaled down, with occasional exaggerated landmarks, billboards, monumental contraptions, or giant whimsical props creating visual rhythm and humor. Text does not cover the canvas: title, numbers, brief descriptions, small legends, and localized annotations are placed in the surrounding negative space with subtle connections to nearby scenes, avoiding bulky white cards, uniform callout boxes, rigid chapter headers, and dense spec sheets. The entire piece adopts a minimalist 2D isometric line-illustration aesthetic: secondary color A fine outlines, secondary color B architectural bodies, primary color background with restrained accent fills, strictly confined to a three-color palette with no gradients, realistic textures, or complex lighting. Buildings and machinery are highly abstracted, iconified, and cartoonish rather than technically accurate, filled with tiny characters, animals, vehicles, and humorous interactions to deliver a "theme park map / magazine editorial map / brand world poster" aesthetic. Focus: generous whitespace, central continuous isometric world, irregular nodes, high scale contrast, scattered peripheral annotations, engaging narrative. Avoid: edge-to-edge industrial zones, rigid partitions, standard process cards, dense text containers, heavy flowchart arrows, realistic factories, blueprints, uniform node sizes.

promptZh:
IP定位卡。
核心目的：回答 IP 为什么存在与商业/情绪定位。
卡片内容：IP名称（中/英）、一句话定位（身份 + 核心价值 + 情绪作用）、3个核心调性标签、目标受众画像。
画面构成：角色全身主形象居中或偏侧大图展示，视觉记忆点用小图标注，搭配大字排版的名称与定位金句，背景留白充足，具备品牌封面感。纯色背景。
IP网感强，形象高度概括，用色克制，如果风格是2d则线条简洁，如果风格不是2d则材质、配件和装饰数量使用克制。小图情况下也有较高辨识度。
默认从主题获取设计需求后先设计视觉隐喻，再设计一个好玩的 ip形象。
默认使用2d 简笔画风，如果有风格指定，则以指定风格优先。
IP默认采用非人的吉祥物形象。
避免：额外的道具（除非是IP形象固定部分），和IP无关的氛围感元素。
主题：{这里是主题描述}，请帮我设计一个好玩的ip形象
promptEn:
IP Positioning Card.
Core purpose: Answer why the IP exists and define its commercial and emotional positioning.
Card content: IP name (Chinese/English), one-sentence positioning (identity + core value + emotional effect), 3 core tone tags, target audience profile.
Composition: Full-body primary character displayed prominently in the center or off-center, with small annotated callouts highlighting its visual signature, paired with large bold typography for the name and positioning slogan, with generous whitespace and a brand cover feel. Solid-color clean background.
High internet presence, highly generalized silhouette, restrained color palette: clean lines if 2D, restrained materials, accessories, and ornaments if not 2D. High recognizability even at thumbnail scale.
Default workflow: Analyze design requirements from the theme, design visual metaphors first, then design a fun IP character.
Default style: 2D doodle / sketch style; if a specific style is designated, prioritize the designated style.
Default IP character: Non-human mascot character.
Avoid: Extraneous props (unless they are a fixed part of the IP character), atmospheric decorative elements unrelated to the IP.
Theme: {theme description}, please design a fun IP character for me.
